jobs.description:
We are customer-obsessed at Navan, and we move fast. We are constantly looking for ways to optimize the Travel & Expense customer experience, so our environment is dynamic, ever-evolving, and anything but traditional corporate.
  
  
To help our global colleague community feel informed, valued, and ready to take on the world, we’re seeking a forward-thinking
**Change & Communications Manager**
. Within our Centre of Excellence, you’ll connect colleagues to our purpose, culture, and operational goals.
  
  
You’ll create engaging communications that keep colleagues informed and aligned with what’s happening across the business, while maintaining our internal communications standards. You’ll also support end-to-end change management for initiatives of all sizes by developing tailored change plans and leading enablement that builds resilience.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Manage communications and change requests: Assess and own incoming requests, keep them aligned with the strategic roadmap, and manage key communication channels day to day.
* Create multimedia content: Produce engaging communications in formats such as video, newsletters, visual assets, and Slack updates.
* Bring structure to change: Develop tailored communication and change plans for a diverse hybrid workforce. Turn complex organizational objectives, product changes, and operational updates into clear narratives and deliverables.
* Build relationships and influence: Work as a trusted advisor, coach, and practitioner with stakeholders at all levels. Collaborate across teams and departments to understand the needs and impact of change and communications on colleagues.
* Measure and improve performance: Analyze qualitative and quantitative data to assess the effectiveness of communications and change efforts. Measures may include asset-level engagement, colleague sentiment, and enablement time.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Relevant experience: At least two years of experience in change management or internal communications, and at least two years in customer service. Change management certification, such as Prosci or CCMP, and leadership experience are preferred.
* Agility: Experience in a fast-paced travel, technology, or SaaS environment. You navigate ambiguity, adapt quickly, and are comfortable working with streamlined processes.
* Storytelling and influence: Ability to turn complex operational information into compelling narratives and influence diverse stakeholders at all levels.
* Cross-functional partnership: A track record of collaborating across teams to build alignment, engagement, and strong working relationships.
* Digital fluency: Familiarity with modern communication channels such as Slack, video, and intranet, and interest in using AI tools to improve colleague enablement.
* Data-informed approach: Comfortable using qualitative feedback and quantitative metrics to track performance, share insights, and adapt communication strategies.
* Ownership and growth: Accountable, self-directed, and able to deliver against clear guardrails and deadlines, with a commitment to continuous learning.

This role will chiefly support the EMEA Ads Marketing team, which is responsible for shaping how our core Netflix Ads positioning is activated and executed across the region, through compelling, differentiated narratives and activations. By activating these messages across both sales channels (presentations, materials, talking points, events) and broader non-sales channels, the team builds widespread awareness and excitement among our key advertising partners. Website, LinkedIn).

We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.
  
  
**About The Role**
LemFi moves money home for people who live between countries. Behind every transfer there is a real story: school fees, a wedding, a mother's new roof. We have the mission, the communities and the brand platform. What we need now is someone who can find those stories, write them, and make them look unmissable.
  
  
You will report to the VP of Brand and Design, and sit at the centre of a lean creative team. You will concept campaigns alongside Isabel, write the words, set the visual direction, and lead the activations that make LemFi feel like it genuinely belongs to the communities it serves. This is not a brief-taking role. You will bring 10 ideas, kill 8, sharpen 2, and then make the 2 real.

* Find the stories: dig into our customers, corridors and cultures, and turn real lives into campaign ideas that land across markets
* Write the work: manifestos, scripts, headlines, social, OOH and launch narratives, copy that is sharp enough to stand alone
* Set the visual direction: art-direct campaigns, shoots and brand films so the idea is as strong visually as it is in words
* Lead activations: concept and run real-world moments, events, partnerships and cultural drops across our markets, from idea to on-the-ground execution
* Brief and direct: brief designers, directors, agencies and creators, push the work until it earns its place
* Build the brand platform: grow the creative system so it scales consistently across channels and corridors, using AI tools to move through concept rounds faster
* Measure what lands: track reach, engagement and brand lift, iterate fast and feed what you learn back into the work

Your experience
  
  

* 4 or more years at a top creative agency as a copywriter, art director or creative, you know what world-class craft actually takes
* 2 or more years building or relaunching a brand at a startup or scale-up, shipping with small teams and tight budgets
* Portfolio that shows at least 1 strong agency campaign and 1 brand you built or rebuilt in-house, with your specific role on each made clear
* Copy and art direction: one is your home craft, the other is genuinely strong, not borrowed from someone else on the brief
* Activations shipped: you have taken ideas off the screen into events, partnerships or cultural moments that actually reached people
* Real-people storytelling: you have made work from human truths, documentary, testimonials, community voices
* Cultural fluency: you understand the communities LemFi serves across its corridors, or you are obsessive about learning them

Nice to have
  
  

* Fintech, remittance or regulated-category experience, including financial promotions
* Rebrand experience end to end: strategy, identity and launch
* Directing or writing shoots and brand films, or long-form editorial work

**Why join LemFi?**
Your work here puts money back into families' pockets. That's the reward, and the weight of it. You'll take on some of the hardest problems in finance alongside people who do their best work when the stakes are real. We move fast and we expect a lot, because our customers can't afford for us to do otherwise. In return you get room to own real problems, global impact you can see, and a team that won't slow you down.
  
  
Bring grit and ownership and there's a place for them here. Ambition belongs here, come and show us yours.
  
  
Follow us on LinkedIn and Instagram and if you haven't already, download the app on the App Store or Google Play.
  
  
Don't feel that you're right for this role, but want to submit your interest in working for LemFi? You can join our talent community to stay in touch for future opportunities.
  
  
**Recruitment agencies notice**
LemFi does not accept unsolicited CVs from recruitment agencies. We work only with agencies on our preferred supplier list, and only when we’ve asked them for their support. Any CVs sent to us outside this arrangement will not incur a fee.
  
  
**AI in hiring at LemFi**
We use AI to cut admin, like notetakers that let interviewers focus on the conversation instead of typing. AI never makes hiring decisions. That responsibility always sits with our hiring teams. Read our AI use policy to see how we use AI and how we expect you to use it too.
